quests.title: The Moon Adorning the Night

dialogue.t: The night sky... The moons...
Looks like she wants to play Moon Chess again. Let's play with her!
Ah, it's you two.

dialogue.sit: Care for a game of chess?

dialogue.t: Sure! I'll set up the night sky for you.
The three moons...
Perhaps... Like this?
Hmm, let me think...
Oh...
Moons... Moons...
How about here?
Looks like I won this round.
My three moons are connected.
Mm, this should win it.
Mm... The moons wax and wane in an endless cycle...
It seems both sets of moons refuse to be eclipsed.
Are we... heading for a tie?
Ah, you weigh your decisions carefully before making them, I see. Take your time — we have plenty of that, after all.
Did you forget how to place your moons in the night sky? Shall I help you?
You don't like this game? Hm... I find it quite amusing myself.
Mm? Are you staring at me? Your gaze is not subtle.
You're staring... Is the truth of the moons written on my face?
The board's over there, by the way...
Hm, your moons are aligned.
The night sky is yours.
Ah... I must have... slipped up somewhere.

dialogue.sit: You have a wonderful time playing the game with Columbina...

dialogue.t: Thank you, I enjoyed that a lot.
If you'd like... feel free to come keep me company again, sometime.
Here, take this as a token of our promise.

quests.description: The Damselette seems to have something she wants to do in the Silvermoon Hall…
